question: A sum of ₹10,000 amounts to ₹12,321 in 2 years at a certain rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The rate of interest per annum is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For Compound Interest, the multiplying factor over 2 years is the square of the annual factor.

Ratio of Amount to Principal (A/P) = 12321 / 10000

Annual multiplier = √(12321 / 10000) = 111 / 100

Rate % = ((111 − 100) / 100) × 100% = 11%

**∴ The correct answer is 11%.**
